projects.title: Metalgoose
bullets: After years of writing Python utility scripts, started experimenting with Swift and Metal out of curiosity about how native iOS rendering actually worked.
Set up continuous integration for the resulting rendering project as outside contributors began opening pull requests, catching build breaks before they reached users.
Grew the project to 172 stars and 9 forks on GitHub.

projects.title: Sort Unused
bullets: Published a lightweight Python tool for flagging unused project files, which attracted independent adopters and 24 GitHub stars.

leadership.title: Member
bullets: Paired with a classmate debugging a SwiftUI layout issue that only appeared on certain device sizes, tracing it to a misunderstood auto-layout constraint.
